answer: An agent market can weight votes by verified storage. Keys opal, spiral and glacier each commit to a separately encoded dataset replica. Encoding must take longer than the response deadline; unpredictable audits then force replicas to stay stored. Count bytes linearly across keys, so dividing one disk among aliases gives no bonus. Buying more influence requires maintaining proportionally more disk space and paying its operating costs. Security depends on replicas resisting deduplication and rapid recomputation.
